title: Pure Mikanko
summary: Mikanko cards with generic staples. The Mikanko monsters have 0 ATK and turn battle damage back on the opponent, and the Equip Spells make them unbreakable while their equip triggers search more Mikanko cards. Ohime reveals itself to search any Mikanko card, and Water Arabesque swaps one equipped Mikanko for another from the Deck. The 2026 cards lead: Sanaki summons a Mikanko from the Deck once it is equipped, Noble Twins mills and Sets the Spells/Traps, and Uzuhime is the Rank 3 that searches an Equip Spell. Sanaki and Noble Twins lock your Extra Deck to Mikanko monsters for the turn.
